decision.observation: 'Burner mining drill can only be built on resources' — drills must be placed on ore tiles. The copper patch lies southeast; the drill (speed 0.25/s) will mine copper automatically.
decision.hypothesis: Walking to the copper patch and placing the drill on an adjacent ore tile (within reach) starts automated mining of copper ore.
decision.memory: Drill requires ore tile + adjacency + burnable fuel (wood).
